The new WSLATL logo, two partner banners, NxtLyfe's new profile, and November's package updates.

New logo
- The logo from the November 2026 brand kit replaces the old white mark everywhere: the header, the browser tab icons, the iPhone and Android home-screen icons, the logo search engines show for the company, and the picture a shared link shows.
- Following the brand guidelines, the header shows the mark on its own at 32px on a solid bar, and the footer no longer repeats it.
- The new logo ships as pictures only, so favicon.svg is gone; its old address now redirects to the new 192px icon.

Partners
- Last Stop and Turtle now have banners on their cards and profiles.
- NxtLyfe (was NxtLyfe ZSR) has an updated profile from their new ad. It now covers both of their servers, NxtLyfe ZSR on FiveM and NxtLyfe Frontier on RedM, with their new Discord invite. Their profile address and referral code stay the same.
- The cards on /partners now load small copies of the banners, which keeps the page fast and within its size budget. Profiles and shared links still use the full banners.

Packages
- Next.js 16.4.5 and the rest of the minor and patch updates from the outdated-packages report, with no security advisories left.

Pull requests
- #46 Package updates (closes #45, replaces #44)
- #47 The new logo
- #48 Partner banners and NxtLyfe's profile

Full changelog: https://github.com/wslatl/wslatl.com/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0
